audit_scope: Phase D0 experimental design and contract freeze only

requirements.requirement: Classify D0 as decision-grade experimental design, not deployment or evidence of strategy effectiveness.
requirements.evidence: PHASE_D0_EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md Decision design and phase boundary; phase_d0_reference.json classification and authorization

requirements.requirement: State the exact decision, cheapest credible experiment, must-have validity work, useful diagnostics, deferred work, and stop/continue rule.
Pin the research-grade candidate panel rather than canonical Phase B or a mutable pointer.
Preserve split_adjusted_price_return, exclusion of cash distributions, preserved dividend gaps, and no total-return claim.
Define row identity, exact PIT membership, decision timestamp, information cutoff, and feature-specific eligibility.
Define source-switch, missing-price, missing-volume, exclusion-code, expected/eligible/scored denominator, and structural-minimum semantics.
Retain 57/60 visibility and never require every official member to possess every feature.
Use unchanged continuous label__open_to_open__20 with exact next-open 20-session endpoint semantics.
Keep 5/10-session labels secondary and future path/excursion labels inaccessible to model construction.
Register every predictor in exactly one of C, P, X, M with exact formula, dependencies, lookback, minimum observations, lag, missingness, range, source, and fold-local transform.
Respect feature caps of C<=8, P<=8, X<=4, M=12, total<=32.
requirements.evidence: Registry counts C=6, P=8, X=4, M=12, total=30; validator feature_caps

requirements.requirement: Keep C conventional and free of all direct, renamed, rescaled, or lag-shifted market-state variables.
requirements.evidence: phase_d0_feature_registry.json C entries uses_market_wide_state=false; validator C_has_no_market_state

requirements.requirement: Carry all 12 corrected v2 market-state variables without outcome-based removal or regime conversion.
Freeze a label-blind P duplicate/near-duplicate criterion, preference, and failure behavior.
Resolve actual P duplicate removals before real execution using only frozen label-blind rules.
requirements.evidence: phase_d0_reference.json chronology.locked_test_open_policy and structural_derivations P_near_duplicate_resolution; after separate owner authorization, D1 may compute registered predictor values through 2024-12-30 while realized labels and all predictive execution remain forbidden; the result freezes before the first fit

requirements.requirement: Define a positive predictor allowlist and prohibit direct or intentional identity encodings.
Specify positive and negative identity-blindness tests for D1.
Freeze exactly four primary cells with identical label, folds, sessions, and comparable row mask.
Freeze exact Ridge and LightGBM estimator classes, objectives, preprocessing, missingness, seeds, and bounded hyperparameters without search.
Freeze the LightGBM C+P+X versus C+P+X+M market-state ablation with disjoint blocks.
Define date-grouped chronological folds, fit/calibration/test intervals, fold-local transforms, and a locked historical test.
Derive purge from actual label endpoint timestamps and explain why no extra embargo is needed.
Resolve exact retained/purged session boundaries and code/environment fingerprints before real execution.
requirements.evidence: phase_d0_reference.json structural_derivations; destination phase_d1_structural_resolution.json; every resolution explicitly freezes before the first real model fit or prediction

requirements.requirement: For every deferred D1 value define permitted inputs, deterministic formula, rounding, bounds, fallback, artifact, and pre-execution freeze.
Prohibit outcomes, feature-label association, scores, IC, tails, and economics from D1 structural resolution.
Define score meaning, calibration population, absolute/training-tail hurdle, valid zero-candidate sessions, no quota relaxation, expiry, repeated signals, and overlap inference.
Keep opportunity mechanics at scientific-contract level without ledgers, orders, allocation, rebalancing, costs, or settlement.
Freeze the required primary and secondary evaluation hierarchy, including within-Q5 as diagnostic only.
Freeze numerical stop/continue thresholds for incremental IC, tail separation, stability, concentration, opportunity count, abstention, frequency, and contributor dependence.
requirements.evidence: phase_d0_reference.json decision_gate; PHASE_D0_EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md Frozen continuation gate

requirements.requirement: Require the rich design to beat the strongest conventional design, not only linear C, and make ties fail.
Parse all machine-readable artifacts and verify unique names/formulas, caps, block separation, folds, derivations, authorization, and manifest hashes.
requirements.evidence: RESEARCH/prototypes/phase_d0/validate_phase_d0.py; final validation command recorded in completion report

requirements.requirement: Record the actual D1 implementation fingerprints and prove formula/timing equivalence on fixtures.
requirements.evidence: No D1 code is authorized in D0; phase_d0_reference.json implementation_fingerprints_and_versions rule
